div.div: كُزْبُرَةٌ , and sometimes, [in the present day commonly,] كُزْبَرَةٌ, (S, K,) Arabic, and well known, (AHn,) [but J says] I think it is arabicized, (S,) [Chald. כּדּסְבָּר , (Gol.)] One of the kinds of seeds that are used in cooking, for seasoning food; (S, K;) [coriander-seed: or the coriander-plant, accord. to the explanation of كُسْبُرَةٌ (which is said in the TA to be a dial. form of كزبرة) in the K.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
